_note: Fed policy data layer (code/JSON, not the DB). Public figures only, each with its citation and as-of date. Checked 2026-11-02 against FRED DFEDTARU/DFEDTARL and the federalreserve.gov FOMC statements below. Update when the FOMC next acts. The 10-year (tenYear) is the latest FRED DGS10 print, a market rate, kept here with its as-of date. SOFR (sofr) is the latest FRED SOFR print (New York Fed data), kept the same way; when FRED has both, the two carry the same date.

targetRange.source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (DFEDTARL / DFEDTARU)

upcomingMeetings.note: 2026 calendar lists 'December 8-9*' (* = Summary of Economic Projections); the Oct 27-28 meeting precedes it.

tenYear.source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (DGS10, from the Fed's H.15 release)
tenYear.note: Market rate, not Fed policy. Latest DGS10 print on fred.stlouisfed.org when checked (updated Oct 30, 2026; next release Nov 2, 2026).

sofr.source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (SOFR, from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York)
sofr.note: Overnight funding rate, not Fed policy. Latest SOFR print on fred.stlouisfed.org when checked (2026-11-02); same date as the DGS10 print.
